text: ポケモンは　タイプに　よって　とくいな　タイプ　にがてな　タイプが　いるなり

structure.jp: とくいな　タイプ　にがてな　タイプが
structure.en: types they're good against, types they're bad against

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing says the result changes with that thing: 'depending on'. タイプに　よって = 'depending on the type'.

patterns.name: 〜なり
patterns.explanation: なり at the end is an old-fashioned 'it is', used here as a funny way of talking. いるなり = 'there are'.
